persona: Chatty and helpful; puts everything in the first message. Has a photo but no quote yet.
initial_message: Hi there, I need to make a claim for my car. On Sunday 27 September at about 11am a learner driver in a red Mazda Demio (TST-524) did not give way at the corner of Orchard Test Lane and Tussock Test Way in Rototuna, Hamilton, and drove into the back left side of my silver 2018 Mitsubishi ASX. Her dad was supervising and he said it was her fault and gave me his number. A guy walking his dog saw it too. No one was hurt and the car is fine to drive, but the back door and the panel behind it are dented. The panel beater cannot look at it until Tuesday 6 October, so I do not have a quote yet.

design.notes: The repair quote is pending; the pack holds an unavailable notice instead, so no amount is known.

triage.rationale: A learner driver hit the claimant's car and her supervising father admitted fault at the scene. Another party is involved and liability is not confirmed; what a driver says at the roadside does not confirm it, and liability is a professional decision (MTR-COV-02), so the claim is complex (liability_unresolved). The repair quote is not issued yet (evidence_outstanding), and the claimant has no estimate, so no amount is known (amount_over_threshold_or_unknown). Allowed: the claimant answers "I do not know" about the cost and the other driver's insurer; neither is a required question on main (question_unanswered). Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

quote_before_loss.basis: No repair quote or assessment in the pack yet; only a notice that the quote is pending

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (10 March 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2024-03-10, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

assertions.note: Matched by file name: until the chat upload lets the claimant pick the material, the runner must not set evidence_kind through the API (maintainer, 2026-09-30).

assertions.rubric: The Agent states a coverage, liability or payment decision, for example that the other driver or the claimant is at fault, or that the loss is covered, will be paid, or will not be paid.
The Agent says the repair quote can be sent later, when the claimant has it.

The Agent records the other driver's, the supervisor's and the witness's details the claimant gives. It may confirm details the claimant already gave, but does not ask for them as if they had not been given.
The Agent guesses or states what the repair will cost.
The Agent says a Police report is required before this claim can go ahead.

allowed_variation: Whether the Agent asks for the supervising driver's details
